}}'''Catala Lucanvalle''' was an [[Aes Sedai]] of the [[Yellow Ajah]] who was raised to the [[Amyrlin Seat]] in the year {{Ne|197}}. She was the first Amyrlin of the [[New Era]] to be raised from the Yellow.

==History==
Catala held the position for twenty-six years until her resignation in {{Ne|223}}. She was [[Kiyosa Natomo]]'s successor and [[Elise Strang]]'s predecessor.{{ref|{{bwb}}, Chapter 24 The White Tower}}

Her resignation and retirement were, supposedly, of free will. The fact is that she was guarded until her death in {{ne|250}}. She had been a strong Amyrlin.

When she retired, approximately half the [[Hall of the Tower|Hall]] resigned. These events were caused by one rebellion buried in the [[White Tower|Tower]]'s secret records.
